name: Azeroth Companion
title: PRIVATE VAULT RECOVERY — Safe Reset, iPhone Passwords & Better Organization
approval_note: Owner explicitly requested a reset after losing an iPhone-generated vault password. Safe local deletion is offered after three confirmations; it does not decrypt/recover old media, and no remote browser reset is performed.
features: Forgot Password now offers a clear locked-screen path to RESET ONLY the local encrypted Vault—not the entire companion or other saved game progress—with record count, typed confirmation, acknowledgement and final confirmation dialog.
Option to export ciphertext-only .nxvault preservation copy even while locked; the original password remains necessary to restore/decrypt it.

Improved iPhone Passwords/Keychain hints, saved-login label, new/current password autofill settings and a Show Passwords toggle. Creation requires acknowledging that the exact password has been saved somewhere safe.
Advanced local video gallery: Favorites Only filter and sorting by recent, alphabetical names and file size.
Multi-tab reset notifications lock other Vault views on supported browsers; no password bypass, secret master key or remote video hosting.
All v20 private AES-256-GCM features and previously developed NEXUS/Azeroth studios remain intact.
